additional_info.subject: ID0472514-DC/Si-D/IL- [ MP / R6 170002058] CP1 Connection Failure CRM:03276000019
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0472514
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-IL SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / R6 170002058
Charger ID / Serial No.:
yU0FM3
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
Following your request and after our check, we can see that the issue is showing for you "EVSE is not ready" is because the Outlet 1 shows the error "DC1 Errorcode:20" that is related with IMD_BC1 – (
Insulation resistance below alarm level: 1359kOhm
).
Please follow the steps below to diagnose and resolve the issue with the BC1 unit:
24V Power Supply:
Verify the 24V power delivery related to the
BC1
to ensure it is within the operational range.
Network Connectivity:
Inspect the network cable for any visible damage. Ensure it is securely seated.
Cable Test & Swap:
Try switching the network cable with a known working one to isolate the issue.
Replacement:
If the cable is confirmed to be
defective
, please proceed with a permanent replacement.
IMD_BC1:
Based on the issue observed, it seems that the error is related to the bender unit. As per the usual troubleshooting guide, at the end it mentions: “If all of these steps fail, please try to replace the bender.”
In this case, it appears that the issue may be related to the green and yellow cables. Before proceeding with the replacement, please try
s
wap BC1 with BC2
.
Change the Modbus address accordingly.
If the problem persists in the original BC1, then proceed to replace the bender unit
8EM5903-0AA00-0AA1
| -BC1, -BC2, -BC3, -BC4 |
Insulation Monitoring Device
​
​​​​​​
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-IL SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
